patterns: Franchise + era swap: techhalla's 'The Walking Dead but it's 1974' (251.9K views, 3.4K likes, 528 bookmarks) and 'Gladiator but it's 1975' (21.5K) won with a six-word title: a famous IP re-shot as a 70s film. Zero explanation, the clip does the work.

'What if X was remade with AI?' is the same engine outside the watchlist: rattecs' Counter-Strike 2 remake (204.8K views, 13.6K likes) and 15notdone's Black Clover remake (1.4K) both list the tool stack (Midjourney V8.2 + Nano Banana 2.1 + Kling 4.0).
3D characters stay the meta for a third day: azed_ai's '3D Celebrity Caricature' prompt share (20.5K, 395 bookmarks, the best bookmark ratio of the day) and his 2D-to-3D transformation (11.7K).
Episodic self-quotes work: EHuanglu's 'ep 02' quoting his 1.37M Disney-style post pulled 11.2K, and techhalla's Gladiator follow-up quoted his own Walking Dead hit.
Model-vs-model comparison posts (fotor_com 40.6K, sunra_ai 34.3K and 20.7K on Seedance 2.5 vs Kling 4.0) get views but only 21-37 likes each, so the comparison format alone is not a signal to copy.

(204.8K views, 13.6K likes) confirmed the remake/what-if format, while Seedance 2.5 vs Kling 4.0 comparison posts drew views but very few likes.

drafts.draft_en:
A biblical epic, but it's 1975.

Same armies, same giant, shot like a 70s Technicolor epic: grain, crash zooms, painted skies.

AI VFX, one evening of work.
drafts.video_tip: 15-20s: 70s film-look montage (heavy grain, warm halation, slow crash zooms). Open on the most iconic shot in the first 2s, 4:3 or 1.85 letterbox, end on a fake vintage title card. No captions needed.

drafts.draft_en:
What if a blockbuster VFX shot was remade like it's 1975?

No CGI polish. Miniatures, matte paintings, film grain.

I rebuilt one with AI. Which era should I do next?
drafts.video_tip: 10-15s split: left the modern clean shot, right the same framing as a 1975 version with miniature-look smoke and visible matte lines. Swipe transition at 3s; end card 'Pick the next decade 👇'.

drafts.draft_en:
Prompt share: 3D VFX creature caricature.

Oversized head, exaggerated features, cinematic studio lighting, film-still quality.

Full prompt below 👇 Drop your results.
drafts.video_tip: 8-10s: a 4-image grid of your 3D caricature creatures, each snapping into a short turntable (2s each); put the full prompt in the first reply image so bookmarks carry the post.

drafts.draft_en:
Episode 2 of my AI VFX short.

Last time the ship crashed. Now we see what crawled out.

Same characters, same world, made shot by shot.
drafts.video_tip: Quote-post your previous episode. 20-30s cut that opens on the cliffhanger frame from ep 01, then the strongest new VFX beat by second 3; end on 'ep 03?' text.

Post it under this tweet, best ones get featured.
